boards.school_name: The University of Texas at Arlington
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UTA study environments, from reservable graduate rooms to library, student-center, and residence-hall spaces.

cards.title: Central Library Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Central Library · 702 Planetarium Place
cards.notes: Choose this library setting when you need either quiet or collaborative seating; the university identifies both kinds of study space in Central Library.
cards.short_summary: A central-campus library choice with quiet and collaborative study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA’s catalog states that Central Library contains numerous study spaces for quiet or collaborative study.
cards.source_title: University Libraries | University of Texas at Arlington University Catalog
cards.access_notes: Library access and service availability can vary; consult the library before planning a visit.

cards.title: Architecture & Fine Arts Library
cards.subtitle: Architecture & Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Set up in UTA’s architecture and fine arts branch library when working near those academic buildings or when Central Library is not your preferred stop.
cards.short_summary: UTA’s branch library in the Architecture and Fine Arts building.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA’s catalog lists a library branch in the Architecture and Fine Arts building.
cards.source_title: University Libraries | University of Texas at Arlington University Catalog
cards.access_notes: Confirm current branch-library access and service details with UTA Libraries.

cards.title: Science & Engineering Library
cards.subtitle: Science & Engineering Building
cards.notes: Use this branch-library setting for a study session based near science and engineering classes; check current library access details before heading over.
cards.short_summary: UTA’s branch library in the Science and Engineering building.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA’s catalog lists a library branch in the Science and Engineering building.
cards.source_title: University Libraries | University of Texas at Arlington University Catalog
cards.access_notes: Confirm current branch-library access and service details with UTA Libraries.

cards.entity_name: The Commons Study Lounges & Private Rooms
cards.title: The Commons Study Lounges & Private Rooms
cards.subtitle: The Commons · west side of campus
cards.notes: Use open lounge seating for an informal session, or reserve a private quiet room through the Commons’ Skedda booking service when focused space is needed.
cards.short_summary: Open study lounges plus reservable private quiet rooms at The Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA says The Commons offers open lounge seating and private quiet rooms, with study-room booking through Skedda.
cards.source_title: The Commons - Student Centers - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Private quiet rooms require booking through Skedda; ask the front desk for help with reserved spaces.

cards.title: University Center Lounge Spaces
cards.subtitle: E.H. Hereford University Center
cards.notes: Bring reading or a laptop to the UC’s lounge areas for a flexible campus stop that can also accommodate meeting with peers or taking a break.
cards.short_summary: Campus lounge areas intended for studying, meeting, or recharging.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA describes lounge spaces in the University Center as places to study, meet with peers, or take a break.
cards.source_title: University Center - Student Centers - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: This is shared lounge seating; availability and noise conditions may vary with events and daily use.

cards.title: Cempazúchitl Study Room
cards.subtitle: EDGE Center · Graduate School
cards.notes: Reserve this four-person graduate study room for a small working session using its 55-inch television and whiteboard; markers and erasers are supplied.
cards.short_summary: A four-person EDGE Center room with a television and whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA lists Cempazúchitl as a four-person study room with a 55-inch television and a 4-by-3 whiteboard.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms - Graduate School - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Available by reservation to master’s and doctoral students only; reserve by the QR code at the room entrance.

cards.title: Cattleya Study Room
cards.subtitle: EDGE Center · Graduate School
cards.notes: Book Cattleya for a group of up to four and use the 55-inch television and supplied whiteboard materials to organize a shared work session.
cards.short_summary: A reservable four-person graduate room equipped for shared work.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA lists Cattleya as a four-person study room with a 55-inch television and a 4-by-3 whiteboard.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms - Graduate School - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Available by reservation to master’s and doctoral students only; reserve by the QR code at the room entrance.

cards.title: Ipê Study Room
cards.subtitle: EDGE Center · Graduate School
cards.notes: Reserve Ipê for a four-person graduate work session and use its wall-mounted 55-inch television plus whiteboard for planning, review, or presentation prep.
cards.short_summary: A four-person graduate study room with display and whiteboard tools.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA lists Ipê as a four-person study room with a 55-inch television and a 4-by-3 whiteboard.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms - Graduate School - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Available by reservation to master’s and doctoral students only; reserve by the QR code at the room entrance.

cards.title: Maverick Hall Study Garden
cards.subtitle: Maverick Hall · UTA Boulevard and Kirby Street
cards.notes: If you live in Maverick Hall, take work outside to the building’s listed Study Garden and use it as a change-of-scene option between indoor sessions.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor study area listed among Maverick Hall’s residence-hall features.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA lists a Study Garden among the features of Maverick Hall.
cards.source_title: Maverick Hall - Housing - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Located in a card-controlled residence hall; access is intended for residents and authorized guests.

cards.title: Maverick Hall Study/TV Lounge
cards.subtitle: Maverick Hall · UTA Boulevard and Kirby Street
cards.notes: Maverick Hall residents can use the listed Study/TV Lounge for an indoor change of setting; plan for shared residential-lounge conditions.
cards.short_summary: An indoor study-and-TV lounge within Maverick Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA lists a Study/TV Lounge among the features of Maverick Hall.
cards.source_title: Maverick Hall - Housing - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Located in a card-controlled residence hall; access is intended for residents and authorized guests.
